meta.name: google-social-media-finder
meta.description: Searches Google to discover social media profiles associated with a person, brand, or username; returns platform name, profile URL, username, bio snippet, and follower count across X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, Threads, and more. Use when user wants to find someone's social media accounts, look up social profiles, discover where a person is active online, find brand social media pages, search social accounts by name, track digital footprint, find influencer profiles, check a company's social presence, locate a public figure's profiles, social media lookup, social media finder, find accounts across platforms, social profile search, online presence discovery, who is this person on social media, what social media does X use, find username across platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找任意个人或品牌的社交媒体账号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速找到某人或品牌在各大社交平台上的账号信息。
copy.tagline_en: Find social media profiles for any person or brand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly locate social media accounts of a person or brand across platforms.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的人名、品牌名或用户名，通过 Google 搜索找到该对象在 X、Instagram、Facebook 等平台的社交账号，并返回平台名称、个人主页链接、用户名、简介片段和粉丝数。
howto.when: 当你要求查找某人的社交账号、寻找品牌社交页面、搜索用户名对应的平台，或询问“某人在哪些社交平台活跃”时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下 Taylor Swift 的社交账号。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出她的各平台主页。

say.text: 搜索 Nike 在哪些社交平台有官方账号。
say.note: Claude 会返回 Nike 的品牌社交页面。

say.text: 查一下用户名“elonmusk”出现在哪些平台。
say.note: Claude 会搜索该用户名对应的社交资料。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can search Google for social media profiles of a person, brand, or username, returning platform name, profile URL, username, bio snippet, and follower count from platforms like X, Instagram, Facebook, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find someone's social accounts, look up brand pages, search for a username across platforms, or inquire about online presence.

say_en.text: Find Taylor Swift's social media accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will search and list her profiles.

say_en.text: Search for Nike's official social media pages.
say_en.note: Claude will return brand social pages.

say_en.text: Check which platforms have the username 'elonmusk'.
say_en.note: Claude will search for that username.
